about: $TMP on a real system. EXPECT=A4H is read off the A4H sandbox through the vsp MCP tool on 2026-10-02 (TDEVC/TDEVCT/TADIR reads, ADT reads and one create each of a PROG and a sub-package, both deleted again and their absence read back). UNMEASURED is what OSD does without a measurement behind it. No host, user or system id: users are named by role.

tdevc.note: one $TMP for the whole system, not one per user; delivered (AS4USER is SAP's delivery user, CREATED_ON is initial)

tadir.note: every object in $TMP carries TADIR-AUTHOR; a local package itself has no TADIR row

nodestructure.objects: only the logged-on user's: the listed objects were exactly the 290 TADIR rows of $TMP whose AUTHOR is that user (2 FUGR, 1 CLAS, 13 PROG, 273 NROB, 1 SUSH not shown as a node), none of the other 7 authors' 11847
nodestructure.subpackages: the logged-on user's local packages (TDEVC-AS4USER = user) whose PARENTCL is '' or '$TMP'; a package of another user with PARENTCL '$TMP' is not listed
nodestructure.user_name: UNMEASURED: the parameter was not sent; OSD reads it as 'whose objects' when a client sends it

createProg.result: created and activated with package $TMP and no transport; the lock answered isLocal=true
createProg.cleanup: deleted through ADT (lock + DELETE); TADIR and REPOSRC read back empty

subpackage.createdThroughAdt: a $-package with superPackage $TMP was created (PARENTCL $TMP, DLVUNIT LOCAL, KORRFLAG ''), then deleted; TDEVC read back empty
subpackage.note: $TMP CAN be a parent: a spike note saying otherwise does not hold on this release

deleteTmp.note: not attempted on a shared system; OSD refuses it because the row is delivered and every client assumes the package

packageDocument.note: the raw GET /sap/bc/adt/packages/%24tmp document was not captured; OSD answers its usual package document with softwareComponent LOCAL and no superPackage
